title: HtmlH4
responsibility: Renders the native h4 element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlH4.attributes
inputs.description: Native h4 attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlH4.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native h4 element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlH4
outputs.description: The actual native h4 element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
